Great price and certified! I used this in my Kenmore side-by-side. Easy to install, but best of all, it removed a noticeable taste from my water! Interesting that the new cartridge seemed to be slightly pressurized as there was a slight "pop" when I removed the red protective cap from the end. I think this also contributed to a slow drip that came from my water dispenser for the first couple of hours, even after dispensing about a gallon of water to flush the line. Not a big deal, though, and everything has been fine for the last couple of weeks. Love that my water now has no aftertaste! Will definitely recommend and buy again.

This filter caused my LG refrigerator to malfunction!! I thought it was odd that all the controls stopped working correctly when I put it in; but I thought this was just terrible luck!! After troubleshooting with LG, and they said they never heard anything like it, they told me to call a service company that they would locate for me. But before I did this, and after my second call to LG and reseting the fridge three times.. I decided to put the old filter I still had back in, and reset it one more time. So I went to work and when I came home.. YAY! My refrigerator works fine again! This mistake could have cost me hundreds or even thousands of dollars being my refrigerator is now seven years old- as they probably would have told me to buy a new one! I usually always purchase a back up filter and at times more than one at a time as they offer better price for two or even three. Thirty days for credit is ridicules. I gave the company a chance to give my my money back and I give up. Maybe Amazon will, not sure, but suggest buying a different one. By the way; I do not as a norm write a bad review.
Update: I did get partial credit and they did want me to return it, which I packaged in a ziplock as we all know it is full of water and it won't come out. I want to say that the one I got was the LG LT500P in case the others are fine. First time I ever had a problem with one. I suggest just stay with those that you know work. It isn't worth the trouble.

I've been looking at replacement filters and reading product reviews, and it seems even the supposedly OEM products are not necessarily OEM, so I took a chance on this affordable alternative. In short, it works. I cycled through the first couple gallons of water as recommended and discarded on some plants. Those first few gallons were cloudy, as expected, but after that the water runs clear. What else can I say? It arrived promptly, well packaged, it fits, installed easily, water and ice taste fine. I recommend it.
